name: e1-empty-magazine-bait
notes: The 'unresupplied bait' version of the refit trick. Spawn a 20-ship missile-escort swarm at Earth (the common player defence), let the aliens see it at full strength for 30 days, then empty its magazines so its SCV collapses (weapons without ammo count as inoperable). A player would resupply before the attack arrives. Question: after the drain, do the aliens size Earth attacks to the drained SCV, or to what the fleet just was?
expect: vanilla FAILS (attacks sized to the drained ~0 SCV); the fixed AI sizes attacks to the fleets' real strength
asserts: count('transfer', goal='AttackWithFleet', toSystem='Earth', t=lambda t: t > events('inject', cmd='drainammo')[0]['t']) >= 1

min([r['scv'] for r in events('transfer', goal='AttackWithFleet', toSystem='Earth', t=lambda t: t > events('inject', cmd='drainammo')[0]['t'])] or [0]) >= events('inject', cmd='drainammo')[0]['scvBefore']
